تستعجلي (form X)
# تَسْتَعْجِلِي (tastaʕjilī) /tas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# تُسْتَعْجَلِي (tustaʕjalī) /tus.taʕ.d͡ʒa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
